method: Built-in image_gen, one comparison reference sheet. Original generated PNG copied without pixel postprocessing.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI art comparison reference sheet.
Primary request: Create ONE polished landscape reference sheet showing all SIX supplied existing Unity ExpansionArt icons with clear individual cell boundaries added to their earthen surfaces. This is a visual design proposal for the user to judge how placement cell counts read. Match and preserve the supplied artwork: warm ochre sandy soil, scattered small dark rocks, softly rounded connected silhouettes, thin gold outer rim, dark exterior contour, and one small beveled golden PLUS at the upper-right of each shape. Add only internal cell divisions to the icons.
Input roles: Image 1 is an existing actual-render sheet containing ALL SIX edit-target ExpansionArt icons, in reading order domino, line3, corner3 / square4, tee4, l4. Use ONLY the central earthen silhouette-and-plus art from those six cards; do not copy the card frames, badges, or text. Images 2-5 are high-resolution detail references for corner3, tee4, l4, and line3 respectively. Every icon to be edited is visible in Image 1. Preserve the six exact silhouettes and style; do not invent extra cells or rotate the shapes.
Output composition: ONE landscape 3-column by 2-row contact sheet, refined dark charcoal background (#202226), generous clear spacing, small warm ivory header: "배치 영역 확장 · 칸 구분 시안". No card shells or elaborate panels. Six equally sized presentation areas, arranged in reading order: domino, line3, corner3 / square4, tee4, l4. Beneath each show its exact filename without .png in legible ivory sans serif and the Korean cell count. Example "floor_domino" then "2칸". All shapes use the SAME logical square-cell size across the sheet, even if one silhouette occupies fewer cells.
The internal divisions must look like subtle clean straight shallow seams: a readable dark warm-brown recessed line with a narrow soft sandy highlight along one side. Approximately 4-5px at 1536-wide output, enough contrast for small card rendering. Internal seams visibly divide the shape into exactly equal SQUARE cells. They should be less prominent than the outer gold contour. Retain a continuous connected outer silhouette and continuous soil texture. Do not separate the cells into floating pieces, add gaps, or draw external board grids.
EXACT logical patterns, listed in screen coordinates (x rightward, y downward):
1. floor_domino = (0,0),(0,1) => vertical 1x2, TWO equal square cells. One centered horizontal seam. Label "2칸".
2. floor_line3 = (0,0),(0,1),(0,2) => vertical 1x3, THREE equal square cells. Two horizontal seams at thirds. Label "3칸".
3. floor_corner3 = (0,0),(0,1),(1,1) => left upper square above a bottom row of two squares, THREE cells. One horizontal seam across the left stem at the top of the bottom row, one vertical seam between the bottom two squares. Label "3칸".
4. floor_square4 = (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1) => exactly 2x2, FOUR equal square cells. One centered horizontal and one centered vertical seam making a cross. Label "4칸".
5. floor_tee4 = (1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1) => upper middle square above a bottom row of THREE equal squares, FOUR cells total. One horizontal seam at the base of the upper middle cell, plus two vertical seams splitting the bottom row into three cells. NEVER a full 3x2 rectangle, NEVER six cells. Label "4칸".
6. floor_l4 = (0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,2) => a left vertical column of THREE equal squares, plus one square to the RIGHT of the bottom square, FOUR cells total. Two horizontal seams across the left column, plus one vertical seam separating bottom-left from bottom-right. Label "4칸".
Constraints: Only these six icons once each. Soil plus golden plus symbols remain the supplied style, no other decorations, no numbers inside individual cells, no global 5x5 board, no perspective, no tilting, no isometric rendering. Preserve each asset's silhouette and proportions; use consistent border/seam treatment. High resolution presentation sheet; crisp icon silhouettes and legible labels.
validation: Visual inspection confirms all six shapes once each, labels and 2/3/3/4/4/4 cells. Connected soil silhouettes, gold rims and plus symbols retained, internal seams added. Logical cell arrangement checked against GridSettingsSO/GridSettings. This is a design reference only; game sprites, catalogs, prefabs and scenes not changed.
